limitations: Behavior change: with security.sandbox_enabled=false (or on non-Darwin without sandbox-exec), run_bash_command / run_persistent_command / interactive_pty now refuse execution instead of falling back to raw host shell. This follows plan RP-02 ('제한을 보장할 수 없으면 명령을 거부하고 raw fallback을 사용하지 않는다'); deployments relying on the old fallback must enable the sandbox backend.
env_var-based provider secrets are no longer injected into bash tool children (by design, FR-01/RP-02 minimal env).
